title: Infinite Drive: Optimal Urban Location of Dynamic Wireless Charging at Signalized Intersections
summary: Dynamic Wireless Power Transfer (DWPT) could eliminate plug-in charging in cities, but optimal urban deployment is complex. This paper develops a mixed-integer programming model that optimizes DWPT location under signalized intersection dynamics -- acceleration, deceleration, and queue-position-dependent dwell time -- through probabilistic signal patterns and saturation headway-based modeling.
